title: An IP address inspector
description:
Look inside IPv4 addresses.

```
Address: 192.168.1.20/24
binary: 11000000.10101000.00000001.00010100
network: 192.168.1.0, broadcast: 192.168.1.255
hosts: 254, private: yes
```
requirements: Parse `a.b.c.d/prefix` and refuse parts outside 0 to 255.
Combine the four parts into one 32-bit number with shifts.
Work out the network and broadcast addresses with masks, and say whether it is private (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16).
stretch: Check your answers with Python's `ipaddress` module.
